detail.title: INTEX AIR KING HC 90 Air Cooler – 90 Litres
detail.overview: Long Air Throw | Multi-directional cooling | Inverter-compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty Bring home powerful, desert-grade cooling with the Intex Air King HC 90 — designed to keep large living spaces comfortable even during peak summer heat. Ideal for spacious living rooms, master bedrooms, or open offices, this high-capacity air cooler delivers strong airflow and consistent cooling throughout the day and night. Equipped with 3-side honeycomb cooling pads that retain up to 45% more water, the Air King HC 90 delivers up to 25% extra cooling for a naturally refreshing experience. Its large 90-litre water tank supports long, uninterrupted operation, reducing the need for frequent refills. Built with a durable, shock- and rust-resistant body and smooth 360-degree wheels, it offers both reliability and easy mobility. With full inverter compatibility and an integrated ice chamber, the cooling never stops — even during power cuts. Product Highlights Large 90 L Water Tank The 90-litre water tank allows long hours of cooling without frequent refills, ensuring consistent airflow even during peak summer heat. Long Air Throw With an impressive air throw of up to 17 meters, this air cooler is ideal for living rooms, large bedrooms, offices, restaurants, and open spaces. Energy-Efficient & Inverter Compatible Designed to deliver powerful cooling while consuming less power, this air cooler is inverter compatible, so you stay cool even during power cuts or voltage fluctuations. High-Efficiency Honeycomb Cooling Pads The 3-sided Honeycomb cooling pads allow 45% extra water retention, which results in 25% extra cooling, making this cooler perfect for hot and dry climates. 3-Speed Fan & 4-Way Air Deflection Choose from three speed settings to suit your comfort. The 4-way air deflection system ensures even airflow, with vertical louvres for side movement and horizontal louvres for upward and downward airflow. Durable Build & Easy Mobility Featuring a double ball bearing motor, the cooler is built for long-lasting performance. 360° castor wheels make it easy to move across rooms with minimal effort. Ice Chamber Add ice or ice packs to enjoy extra cooling during peak summer heat, delivering a faster and more refreshing airflow when you need it most. Collapsible Louvres The fully collapsible louvres make cleaning simple and maintenance easy, helping maintain efficient cooling performance season after season. 1-year warranty Complete peace of mind with a 1-year manufacturer warranty, ensuring reliable performance and dependable after-sales support. Ideal For Large bedrooms, substantial living rooms, or medium-sized offices. They balance high capacity with ease of mobility, perfect for general home use in dry climates.
